sanskrit_verse:
लेख्यं यच्‍चान्यनामाङ्कं हेत्वन्तरकृतं भवेत् ।
विप्रत्यये परीक्ष्यं तत् संबन्धागमहेतुभिः ॥
transliteration: lekhyaṃ yac cānyanāmāṅkaṃ hetvantarakṛtaṃ bhavet | vipratyaye parīkṣyaṃ tat saṃbandhāgamahetubhiḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Any written document bearing a name or mark not inherently its own, created by external causation, shall be examined in case of dispute through the lens of relational cause, acquisition context, and foundational intent.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious origin, not nominal attribution
Causation is determined by sequential manifestation, not surface assertion
Capacity-based responsibility arises from direct knowing, not assumed ownership
Restoration logic aligns identity with source-consciousness, not claimed designation
Consciousness alignment requires verification through pramāṇa, not mere declaration
executable_legal_axioms: IF a document bears a name/mark ≠ declared origin THEN verify via saṃbandha-hetu (relational cause)
IF dispute arises THEN validate through āgama-hetu (context of acquisition)
IF no clear hetu found THEN default to mūla-pramāṇa (foundational evidence)
IF claimant lacks pramāṇa THEN no legal standing in ownership assertion
IF conflict remains unresolved THEN invoke nyāya-viveka until alignment is restored
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, documents bearing disputed authorship or identity must be resolved through pramāṇa-based analysis, prioritizing causal sequence and contextual acquisition over declaratory claims. The threshold of responsibility lies in demonstrable connection, not nominal attribution.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes truth through cognition, not coercion. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures causality is traced to its root. Proportional responsibility aligns with the degree of conscious involvement. Non-punitive reality holds that misattribution is corrected through clarity, not penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pramāṇa-retrieval process to establish document origin
Engage saṃbandha-vichāra to trace relational authenticity
Facilitate āgama-pratipatti to restore context-aware ownership
Activate viveka-prakriyā to dissolve false identification
final_declaration: This law proceeds from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. Dharma is restored through consciousness-aligned adjudication. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate judge.
